name: demiurge-ecosystem
description: Demiurge Studio — local-first game creator suite on the Demiurge Protocol

scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace=sdk && npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/qor-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/drc369-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/agent-foundry
scripts.studio:project: npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/cli && npx demiurge studio project
scripts.wallet-wasm:build: npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/wallet-wasm && npm run copy-wasm --workspace=@demiurge/hub
scripts.vercel:build:marketing: npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/qor-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/marketing-site
scripts.vercel:build:hub: npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/qor-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/drc369-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/sdk && npm run copy-wasm --workspace=@demiurge/hub && npm run build --workspace=@demiurge/hub
scripts.publish:sdk: npm run build:sdk && npm publish --workspace=sdk --access public && npm publish --workspace=packages/qor-sdk --access public && npm publish --workspace=packages/drc369-sdk --access public && npm publish --workspace=packages/agent-foundry --access public
